text: Which genes are enriched in pancreas, either on its own or together with a few other tissues?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Pancreas / Tissue enriched, Group enriched
understanding: The question asks for genes that show RNA specificity/enrichment in the pancreas, either solely in the pancreas (tissue enriched) or shared with a few other tissues (group enriched). In HPA, tissue specificity categories (such as Tissue enriched and Group enriched) across defined tissues are queried using the 'Tissue category (RNA)' field.
